rules.statement: A court may grant an extension of time to file objections under section 91A(1) and (2) of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a day is fixed or time appointed for doing any act or taking any proceeding by a party to the action, the court may, from time to time, upon the motions of such party and if sufficient cause is shown, fix another day or enlarge or abridge the time appointed, upon such terms, if any, as to it may seem proper.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 91A of the Civil Procedure Code
